gaps_found: No explicit DMARC/DKIM/SPF at suite perimeter model
No spam/phishing block rate metric (Gmail 99.9% bar not captured)
No AI-assisted features position (risks and privacy constraints)
Accessibility coverage lacked testing methodology (axe-core CI + screen-reader manual)
No compliance certification gate (SOC2/ISO27001/GDPR/HIPAA) as GA requirement
No DMARC/DKIM/SPF model in data model or ACs
No ARC (Authenticated Received Chain) for forwarded mail
No DLP classification field on MailMessage
No deliverability warmup and reputation model
No AI-assisted compose with DEK-bounded constraint
Mailing list management not in any wave
S/MIME placement correct (GA) but ARC omitted
No message edit/delete with audit trail
No presence/status model with pillar isolation
Competitive[Slack] missing all Slack feature strengths
No CalDAV/iCal RFC 5545 protocol compatibility (only mentioned in GA wave as 'adapters')
No IANA time zone mandatory model - could allow fixed-offset-only storage
No scheduling assistant with free/busy-only cross-pillar projection
No working hours / focus time entity
No cross-org free/busy federation protocol specification
Calendar competitive missing Apple Calendar entirely
